## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Full pytest suite passes locally or in CI
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private chat data, production databases, or personal information are included
- [ ] Behavior changes include regression coverage where practical
- [ ] Stateful behavior reuses the existing architecture owner instead of adding a competing state machine
- [ ] No additional model call or background service was introduced without a demonstrated need

## Notes

External pull requests are not accepted by default. See `CONTRIBUTING.md` before preparing a substantial contribution.
